Would you want your local coffee shop to know your usual order instantly? 👇

post.news: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol announced plans to use AI to recognize customers at the drive-thru and show personalized digital menus.
post.take: My coffee addiction already knows me too well. Now even the menu is going to judge my daily sugar choices.
post.insight: Brands are turning the drive-thru into a personalized screen, using data to speed up ordering and sell you more.
